svg.aria-label: Agent answers a panic question by comparing the drawdown to its historical distribution

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: Looks like we're down. Should I stop trading?

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: No. The account is −5.98%, but that has 3x leverage on it —

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: what the strategy actually took is −1.98%.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: Daily sigma for this book is 0.714% (13.6% annualised). This

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: spell is 1.17 days, so window sigma is 0.77% → z = −2.56.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: Large, but not a tail. On the drawdown distribution it is

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: z = −0.40, and 25% of the past 309 days sat deeper.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: The worst in that window was −6.10%, but it took 27.3 days

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: to get there, so z = −1.64. That one was about duration,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: Under water for 1d 4h. Of 262 past spells, 13% ran longer;

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', Pretendard, sans-serif

svg.text: the longest was 45 days. The −10% size-down rung is still
